description.value: Lost Lake Lodge is a suite-style condo-hotel tucked into Whistler's Benchlands neighbourhood, backing onto the Chateau Whistler Golf Course and bordered by Lost Lake Park — making it an appealing base for cyclists exploring the area's trail networks. The property offers fully equipped 1- and 2-bedroom suites with full kitchens, a year-round outdoor heated pool, fitness room, and game room. Guests can reach the ski gondolas and village via a free Upper Village Shuttle, and a 'Bike Rentals' link on the site suggests awareness of cycling as a core guest activity.

address.value: 4660 Blackcomb Way, Whistler, British Columbia V0N 1B4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms Lost Lake Lodge as a real, operating condo-hotel in Whistler's Benchlands area with 1- and 2-bedroom suites. The amenities page explicitly lists 'Washer / Dryer' and 'High Speed Wireless Internet / Free Internet access', confirming laundry and Wi-Fi. No mention of bike storage, bike procedure, drying areas, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site; the 'Bike Rentals' featured link points to an external service rather than on-site facilities. The OSM phone (+1-866-580-6647) does not match either number on the website (604-935-1177 Canada/USA; 1-888-621-1177 worldwide), flagged as a discrepancy.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-866-580-6647 but the website prominently lists 604-935-1177 (Canada & USA) and 1-888-621-1177 (Worldwide). The website numbers have been used in this record; the OSM tag should be updated.
